title: Normalized semilinear systems are closed under tensor and inverse image
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $B_1\leftarrow B_2\leftarrow\cdots$ a strict inverse sequence of sheaves of commutative rings. Let $\mathscr S(B)$ be the abelian category of $B_n$-module sheaves with semilinear transitions $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{n+1,n}M_n$ and componentwise compatible module maps [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Use its unbounded derived category. Call $M$ normalized when every transition-adjoint $\alpha^M_{m,n}:M_m\otimes^L_{B_m}B_n\to M_n$, $m\ge n\ge1$, is invertible; derived scalar extension uses the tensor/restriction adjunction of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings, lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Use the simultaneous enhanced section models of tensor and pullback in that node.

For normalized $P,Q\in D(\mathscr S(B))$, their fiberwise derived tensor system $T=P\otimes^LQ$ is normalized. More precisely its transition-adjoint is the composite
$$
(P_m\otimes^L_{B_m}Q_m)\otimes^L_{B_m}B_n
\xrightarrow{\sim}(P_m\otimes^L_{B_m}B_n)\otimes^L_{B_n}(Q_m\otimes^L_{B_m}B_n)
\xrightarrow{\alpha^P_{m,n}\otimes\alpha^Q_{m,n}}P_n\otimes^L_{B_n}Q_n.
$$
The first arrow is the canonical strong monoidal scalar-extension comparison, and these are the adjoints of the actual system transitions, with their quotient cocycles, not independently chosen reduction isomorphisms.

Let moreover $v:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C')\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ be a morphism of topoi presented by a small site $\mathcal C'$, and put $C_n=v^{-1}B_n$ with its induced transitions. Then the system inverse image $v^*P$ is normalized over $(C_n)$: its transition-adjoint is $v^{-1}\alpha^P_{m,n}$ under the canonical comparison
$$(v^{-1}P_m)\otimes^L_{C_m}C_n\cong v^{-1}(P_m\otimes^L_{B_m}B_n).$$
These statements hold for unbounded complexes without flatness of the transition ring maps.
